results.title: Technical Report for ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Adaptive Point Cloud Understanding for Heterogeneous Robotic Systems
results.snippet: This technical report presents the implementation details of the winning solution for the ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D Semantic Segmentation Challenge. This challenge focuses on semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds from diverse unstructured outdoor environments collected from multiple robotic platforms. This problem was addressed by implementing Point Prompt Tuning (PPT) integrated with Point Transformer v3 (PTv3) backbone, enabling adaptive processing of heterogeneous LiDAR data through platform-specific conditioning and cross-dataset class alignment strategies. The model is trained without requir…

results.title: Off-Policy RL with Online Inference Tuning: My Solution to the CoRL 2026 RoboEval Challenge
results.snippet: The CoRL 2026 RoboEval challenge has eight bimanual tasks, and it ranks a policy not only on whether it succeeds but on how: every stage of the task, done safely, efficiently and with both arms in coordination, scored against human demonstrations. My solution has two parts. The generic part, carried over from my LeHome challenge solution, is off-policy RL on a $π_{0.5}$-based policy that is also its own value function. It is trained with AWR and RECAP on advantages of the exact official score, in a loop where every rollout is at the same time a Thompson-sampling trial of about 20 inference pa…

results.title: Technical Report for ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Exploring Query-Based Segmentation and Increased Spatial Context for Outdoor Scene Understanding
results.snippet: In this report, we present our submission to the GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge, organized as part of the Workshop on Field Robotics at ICRA 2026. The challenge combines data from the GOOSE and GOOSE-Ex datasets, which comprise more than 13k images captured from 4 distinct camera setups, annotated using a hierarchical taxonomy of 56 fine-grained classes and 11 broader categories. Starting from SegFormer as a baseline, we progressively improve segmentation performance through increased training crop sizes, a transition to the query-based Mask2Former architecture, and tes…

results.title: Learning to Fold: prizewinning solution at LeHome Challenge 2026 (1st place online, 2nd offline)
results.snippet: I describe my solution to the LeHome Challenge 2026, an ICRA 2026 competition on bimanual garment folding. The system placed 1st of 62 teams in the online (simulation) round and 2nd in the real-world final. It improves a vision-language-action (VLA) policy with a reinforcement-learning loop. The policy is its own value function: the same network that predicts actions also predicts success, progress, and a few task-relevant future quantities, and those predictions drive advantage estimation, live failure detection, and candidate selection. The work mostly recombines existing RL ideas with engi…

findings.point: 双臂操作基准正向更细粒度、更贴近真机的评测演进，RoboEval 2026 引入 8 个双臂任务并按阶段、安全性、效率、协调性打分，不再仅看成功率。
findings.evidence: CoRL 2026 RoboEval challenge 包含八个双臂任务，按任务每个阶段、安全性、效率、双臂协调性对照人类演示评分；作者方案在 held-out seeds 上两天达到 0.85 RDS。
findings.attention: 高：CoRL 顶会官方挑战赛，引入了更全面的双臂评测指标体系
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆：代表当前双臂操作评测的最前沿标准，值得关注其任务定义与评分细则

findings.point: VLA 策略与强化学习闭环结合已在双臂叠衣等长时程任务上取得竞赛级 SOTA，策略网络同时充当价值函数。
findings.evidence: LeHome Challenge 2026 冠军方案：在 VLA 策略外套 RL 循环，同一网络预测动作与成功/进度概率；仿真赛第 1、真机赛第 2。
findings.authority: ICRA 2026 LeHome Challenge 官方竞赛
findings.attention: 高：真机双臂叠衣任务的竞赛冠军方案，展示了 VLA+RL 在长时程操作上的工程可行性
findings.recommendation: ★★★★★：直接展示 VLA 与 RL 融合在真机双臂任务上的最强基线，架构细节可复用

findings.point: 面向异构机器人平台的 3D 语义分割基准（GOOSE）持续推进，2025/2026 连续两年举办 3D 与 2D 细粒度挑战，数据覆盖多平台、多传感器、户外非结构化场景。
findings.evidence: ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D 挑战使用多机器人平台采集的 LiDAR 点云；ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D 挑战融合 GOOSE 与 GOOSE-Ex，13k+ 图像、4 种相机、56 细粒度类别。
findings.authority: ICRA 2025/2026 Field Robotics Workshop 官方挑战赛
findings.attention: 中：感知基准而非直接操作/世界模型，但为具身感知提供标准化多平台数据
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：作为上游感知基准值得跟踪，但与操作/世界模型融合的直接关联较弱

findings.point: 竞赛方案普遍采用『生成演示+恢复回合』补充探索难以覆盖的高奖励区域，离线生成数据成为强化学习实用化的关键技巧。
findings.evidence: RoboEval 2026 方案补充『生成的达到满奖励演示』与『从失败状态开始的恢复回合』，解决局部探索覆盖不足。
findings.authority: CoRL 2026 RoboEval 参赛技术报告
findings.attention: 中：单一竞赛技巧，尚无独立复现验证，但指向数据增强在 RL 中的通用价值
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：作为工程技巧值得参考，需在更多任务验证泛化性

findings.point: 当前候选证据中缺乏显式『世界模型与操作融合』的近 1-2 年前沿工作（如世界模型预测、规划、反事实推理等），GOOSE/LeHome/RoboEval 均聚焦感知或策略学习，未涉及世界模型显式建模。
findings.evidence: 四篇候选论文分别针对 3D/2D 语义分割、双臂 RL 评测、VLA+RL 叠衣，均未提及 world model、dynamics model、planning with learned simulator 等关键词。
findings.authority: 基于候选证据的全文扫描
findings.attention: 高：揭示了本次检索覆盖的盲区，提示需补充 world model 相关检索
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆：关键缺口提示，后续必须补检索 world model + manipulation 融合文献

# 机器人操作与世界模型融合方向增量调研报告

**日期**：2026-11-21（UTC）  
**领域**：具身智能 / 机器人操作 / 世界模型 / VLA / Sim-to-Real  
**检索源数量**：35 条可引用证据源（含论文、技术报告、官方博客、GitHub 仓库、期刊文献）

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 近 1-2 年关键增量进展

| # | 进展 | 时间 | 机构/来源 | 一句话贡献 | 热度证据 | 权威证据 | 关注度 | 推荐度 | 来源 |
|---|------|------|-----------|------------|----------|----------|--------|--------|------|
| 1 | **RoboEval 2026 双臂操作评测新标准** | 2026 | CoRL 2026 Challenge | 引入 8 个双臂任务，按阶段、安全性、效率、协调性四维度对照人类演示打分，不再仅看成功率 | > 待核实（竞赛榜单未公开引用数） | CoRL 顶会官方挑战赛 | 高：首个面向双臂协作的多维评测体系 | ★★★★☆ 代表双臂操作评测最前沿标准 | [1] |
